name: CHROME GOLD
note: owner 2 Nov: liquid chrome-gold (shadow #332814 mid #a4845d highlight #f0e6c7 hot #fef9e8) over completely see-through glass. NAV-102 repeats (blue only); SCR-16 repeats (chartreuse); TXT-04 (blue, violet) with a gold sweep; HOV-103 (blue, violet).

effects.name: Split Preview
effects.where: THE TOUR menu (top right): opens a full-screen split: the 8 stops on the left, a live miniature of the stop you point at on the right

effects.name: Crown Set
effects.where: Main CTA: CLAIM YOUR FOUNDING TICKET (hero). A watch-style button: hover winds the crown, press pulls it out, release snaps it home

effects.name: Bevel Diamond
effects.where: Text alerts card (FIRST WORD, BY TEXT): a bevelled glass diamond that turns over to show the sample text

effects.name: Exploded Layers
effects.where: The scroll section HOW WE CHOOSE: a glass-and-metal device pulls apart into six labelled slices, one per step

effects.name: Scroll Highlight
effects.where: Both big reading statements: lit words go white, key phrases take the chrome-gold gradient with a moving sheen and underline

effects.name: Edge Light
effects.where: Hover on the top menu buttons and every card group (markets, bento, tiers, collection, text-alert form, sign-up cards): a light in the metal runs along the edges

effects.name: Mercury Bead
effects.where: Secondary sign-up button: SEND MY SHORTLIST (after the four questions). A bead of liquid chrome rolls toward the pointer
